access_memberships_scope_shape_check.name: access_memberships_scope_shape_check
access_memberships_scope_shape_check.value:
(
        ("app"."access_memberships"."scope_type" = 'platform' and "app"."access_memberships"."brand_id" is null and "app"."access_memberships"."organization_id" is null and "app"."access_memberships"."territory_id" is null and "app"."access_memberships"."outlet_id" is null)
        or ("app"."access_memberships"."scope_type" = 'brand' and "app"."access_memberships"."brand_id" is not null and "app"."access_memberships"."organization_id" is null and "app"."access_memberships"."territory_id" is null and "app"."access_memberships"."outlet_id" is null)
        or ("app"."access_memberships"."scope_type" = 'organization' and "app"."access_memberships"."brand_id" is not null and "app"."access_memberships"."organization_id" is not null and "app"."access_memberships"."territory_id" is null and "app"."access_memberships"."outlet_id" is null)
        or ("app"."access_memberships"."scope_type" = 'territory' and "app"."access_memberships"."brand_id" is not null and "app"."access_memberships"."organization_id" is null and "app"."access_memberships"."territory_id" is not null and "app"."access_memberships"."outlet_id" is null)
        or ("app"."access_memberships"."scope_type" = 'outlet' and "app"."access_memberships"."brand_id" is not null and "app"."access_memberships"."organization_id" is not null and "app"."access_memberships"."territory_id" is not null and "app"."access_memberships"."outlet_id" is not null)
      )

idempotency_records_in_progress_state_ch.name: idempotency_records_in_progress_state_check
idempotency_records_in_progress_state_ch.value: "app"."idempotency_records"."status" <> 'in_progress' or ("app"."idempotency_records"."owner_token" is not null and "app"."idempotency_records"."lease_expires_at" is not null and "app"."idempotency_records"."completed_at" is null)

idempotency_records_completed_state_chec.name: idempotency_records_completed_state_check
idempotency_records_completed_state_chec.value: "app"."idempotency_records"."status" <> 'completed' or ("app"."idempotency_records"."owner_token" is null and "app"."idempotency_records"."lease_expires_at" is null and "app"."idempotency_records"."completed_at" is not null)

idempotency_records_failed_state_check.name: idempotency_records_failed_state_check
idempotency_records_failed_state_check.value: "app"."idempotency_records"."status" <> 'failed' or ("app"."idempotency_records"."owner_token" is null and "app"."idempotency_records"."lease_expires_at" is null)

outbox_events_pending_state_check.name: outbox_events_pending_state_check
outbox_events_pending_state_check.value: "app"."outbox_events"."status" <> 'pending' or ("app"."outbox_events"."lease_token" is null and "app"."outbox_events"."lease_expires_at" is null and "app"."outbox_events"."published_at" is null)

outbox_events_processing_state_check.name: outbox_events_processing_state_check
outbox_events_processing_state_check.value: "app"."outbox_events"."status" <> 'processing' or ("app"."outbox_events"."lease_token" is not null and "app"."outbox_events"."lease_expires_at" is not null and "app"."outbox_events"."published_at" is null)

outbox_events_published_state_check.name: outbox_events_published_state_check
outbox_events_published_state_check.value: "app"."outbox_events"."status" <> 'published' or ("app"."outbox_events"."lease_token" is null and "app"."outbox_events"."lease_expires_at" is null and "app"."outbox_events"."published_at" is not null)

outbox_events_dead_letter_state_check.name: outbox_events_dead_letter_state_check
outbox_events_dead_letter_state_check.value: "app"."outbox_events"."status" <> 'dead_letter' or ("app"."outbox_events"."lease_token" is null and "app"."outbox_events"."lease_expires_at" is null and "app"."outbox_events"."published_at" is null)
